purpose: Immutable self-scoped idempotency receipt for one guarded B02-D Undo of an exact Schedule unschedule receipt; it binds the retained prior placement to one newly created monotonic MaterialStateRef.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated self Person scope owning the Undo receipt.
columns.value_contract: Must match the self scope of the referenced unschedule receipt.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.meaning: Client/application identity for idempotent Undo replay.

columns.name: intent_fingerprint
columns.meaning: Deterministic fingerprint of ScheduleRef and exact unschedule operation identity.

columns.name: schedule_ref
columns.meaning: Stable retained Schedule restored to current placement.
columns.value_contract: Must equal the Schedule recorded by the unschedule receipt.

columns.name: unschedule_operation_id
columns.meaning: Exact prior unschedule receipt authorized for one Undo.

columns.name: restored_from_material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Retained prior placement state whose floating-local semantics are copied.
columns.value_contract: References the state closed by the exact unschedule operation.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: New immutable placement MaterialStateRef produced by accepted Undo.
columns.value_contract: Application-issued UUIDv7; never reuses or reopens the old state.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Authoritative instant shared by the new current binding and history episode.
columns.value_contract: Recorded inside the bounded database capability.

primary_key.name: pk_schedule_unschedule_undo_operation
primary_key.reason: One immutable Undo receipt per self-scoped operation identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_unschedule_undo_op_unschedule_operation
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind Undo to the exact self-scoped unschedule receipt.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_unschedule_undo_operation_schedule_ref_schedule
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Retain one stable Schedule identity across withdrawal and restoration.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_unschedule_undo_op_restored_state_placement_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Retain the exact closed state whose semantic interval is copied.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_unschedule_undo_op_material_state_placement_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind replay to the new immutable placement state created by Undo.

unique_constraints.name: uq_schedule_unschedule_undo_operation_material_state_ref
unique_constraints.reason: A restored placement MaterialState belongs to one Undo receipt.

unique_constraints.name: uq_schedule_unschedule_undo_operation_unschedule
unique_constraints.reason: One exact self-scoped unschedule receipt may be undone at most once.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_unschedule_undo_operation_operation_id
check_constraints.reason: Keep Undo operation identity canonical and bounded.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_unschedule_undo_operation_unschedule_operation_id
check_constraints.reason: Keep the referenced unschedule operation identity canonical and bounded.

indexes.name: uq_schedule_unschedule_undo_operation_material_state_ref
indexes.reason: One receipt per produced restored state.

indexes.name: uq_schedule_unschedule_undo_operation_unschedule
indexes.reason: Enforce at most one Undo for the exact unschedule receipt.

indexes.name: ix_schedule_unschedule_undo_operation_schedule_ref
indexes.reason: Operational inspection of Undo receipts per retained Schedule.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Creates one new immutable schedule.placement MaterialState by copying the retained prior floating-local interval semantics.
state_history.current_binding: Requires continued real absence and no later history episode, then creates one new current binding and open history episode.
state_history.chronology: created_at is strictly later than the closed unschedule boundary and starts the new history episode.
state_history.immutability_policy: Never reopens the old history row or reuses the old MaterialStateRef; replay returns the recorded new state.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: No direct runtime table privileges; downgrade fails closed while Undo receipts exist.

obligations: runtime has no direct table read/write privilege
Undo requires the exact self-scoped unschedule receipt
Undo conflicts when currentness exists or any later placement history episode exists
accepted Undo creates a new MaterialStateRef and a new open history episode
same operation and intent replay without reopening or rewriting prior history
